caption:
Ninety seconds, start to finish. Here is what actually happens in them.

The enquiry arrives. A text, a web form, a missed call, a message on your Google listing. It gets answered immediately, whatever time it is.

It asks the three things that decide the price. What the job is, roughly how big, and where they are. Not an interrogation, a conversation, and anything unusual gets handed to a person.

The price goes into the same thread they are already reading. No attachment, no callback, no waiting for a site visit on something that does not need one. The rules behind that number are yours, including the floors that keep the work profitable.

Then it books, while they are still holding the phone and still sure. Confirmation and reminders go out on their own.

And you find out about all of it when you next look up from the job you were on.

If you want to see how this would run on your own pricing, book a twenty minute walkthrough at scaileai.com.
